Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting NAS devices leveraging zero-day vulnerability in Photo Station
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in Photo Station
Indicators of Compromise: Surge in DeadBolt submissions to ID Ransomware
Photo Station versions vulnerable: 6.1.2 and earlier, 6.0.22 and earlier, 5.7.18 and earlier, 5.4.15 and earlier, 5.2.14 and earlier
